text:
Alex: hey all — first day! hitting an Okta device-trust loop when I try to sign in, and I don't see the eng-drive folder in GDrive. 1Password invite also didn't come through. who should I ping?

Priya (IT): welcome! :wave: can you paste the exact Okta error? also what OS is your laptop?

Alex: macOS Ventura 13.5. Okta shows a modal: 'Device not managed — device trust required'. clicking enroll redirects to a page that immediately errors. Screenshot attached in thread.

it-ops-bot: Ticket #INC-2026 created for okta-device-trust:2678901234. Assigned to Tom (Infra). ETA 2h.

Tom (Infra): on it. quick checklist: 1) confirm Jamf/MDM is installed, 2) confirm you have the Okta Device Trust profile in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Profiles, 3) check browser extension is not blocking redirects.

Alex: Jamf app is installed but under Jamf it says 'MDM profile missing'. Browser is Chrome stable.

Priya (IT): OK — I just pushed a re-enroll invite for Jamf and reissued the Okta device-trust cert for your account. Check your inbox (alex@redwood.dev) and the 1Password vault 'IT Onboarding' for a Jamf link.

1Password-bot: 1Password invite resent to alex@redwood.dev (item: Redwood - New Hire Seat).

Sophia (Eng): fwiw, I can add you to eng-all and eng-drive if you want access immediately. confirm your google email?

Alex: alex@redwood.dev — please add me, Sophia.

Tom (Infra): I triggered Jamf enroll again — when you get the Jamf window, run the command if prompted: 

```
/usr/local/bin/jamf enroll -prompt
```

If the MDM profile still shows missing after that, paste the output of:

```
profiles status -type enrollment
```

so I can check the MDM provisioning logs.

Alex: ran enroll command, Jamf reported success. Ran `profiles status -type enrollment` and it shows: 

```
Device is enrolled via MDM: YES
MDM Server: Jamf Pro (ID: jamf-01)
Profiles installed: 3
```

Tom (Infra): great — I cleared the Okta device-trust flag on your account. Try logging in again (use an incognito window to avoid stale cookies).

Alex: re-logged in in incognito — Okta accepted device trust and I got into console. Drive shows eng-drive folder now. 1Password invite popped up too and I accepted.

Priya (IT): wonderful — added note to ticket: resolved by Jamf re-enroll + Okta reissue. Marking INC-2026 resolved. If anything flares up, ping #eng-infra or me directly.

Alex: thank you all! super smooth. tagging Sophia to say hi :wave:

Sophia (Eng): welcome to Redwood! grab me if you want a quick tour of repo layout later. :slightly_smiling_face:
